title: The layers of opengrid, from the query model up
description: At the bottom a query model: typed columns, a query as a JSON document and columnar results. On it the engine in Rust, which filters, sorts, groups and builds pivots and trees, with a planner that splits a query between a server and the tab. The engine is built for three targets: WebAssembly in the tab, native code inside opengrid-server, and SQL for PostgreSQL and SQLite. Only the top layer, the three Web Components, knows about a browser.
source: crates/*/Cargo.toml: only opengrid-web-core and opengrid-web-components depend on web-sys and js-sys
